3. **Cool Season (November to February)**: Considered the best time to visit, temperatures are more comfortable, ranging from 20°C to 30°C (68°F to 86°F). It's drier and popular for outdoor activities.

In October, for instance, you can expect intermittent rain but also warm temperatures. Always check local forecasts for specific areas before traveling!
